{{Top|leg}}
The '''strength upgrade''' module allowed for an increase of a [[Droid/Legends|droid's]] strength and resilience by removing of most of the factory-installed safety restrictions put in place during its manufacture.

==Behind the scenes==
A droid must be at upgrade class 2 to be able to equip this item.

==Appearances==
*''[[Star Wars: Knights of the Old Republic II: The Sith Lords]]''
